استجوبن (form X)
# اِسْتَجْوَبْنَ (istajwabna) /is.tad͡ʒ.wab.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَجْوَبَ (istajwaba)
# اُسْتُجْوِبْنَ (ustujwibna) /us.tud͡ʒ.wib.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَجْوَبَ (istajwaba)
# اِسْتَجْوِبْنَ (istajwibna) /is.tad͡ʒ.wib.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَجْوَبَ (istajwaba)
